_comment: BRIEFING - the fifth b0b.dev film, built by scripts/build-intro-collage.py --spec scripts/film-briefing.json.
Made 21 Oct 2026 at the author’s instruction: "Make a video for briefing and have that be what replaces endgame as the starting video."
It follows the Briefing at /start: the thesis, the maxim, identity, the insignia, precedents, the paradox, holdings, method.
b0b.dev is never called "the institution" (CLAUDE.md section 2). Faces: none. Precedents are named, never shown.
Pictures: the site’s own (seal, jacket, map, stickers, page screenshots; scripts/film-briefing-media.py) and licensed
masters reused from the Endgame spec with their licences. The reel and its js go to the build dir; the site serves only the
subtitled file, public/b0b-briefing-film.{mp4,webm}, on the landing and on /start.

voice.licence: Piper voice en_GB cori (high); training data LibriVox, public domain per the model card

lines.text: The intelligence agency is the artwork. The intelligence work is real.
b0b.dev is an independent intelligence research operation. Its identity is the work; its research is sourced, tiered and correctable.
lines.say: B zero B dot dev is an independent intelligence research operation. Its identity is the work; its research is sourced, tiered, and correctable.

lines.text: It is not a themed website, a role-play or a satire. It is not a fictional agency producing fictional research.

shots.text: The intelligence agency is the artwork. The intelligence work is real.

shots.head: What it is not
rows: an OSINT dashboard with artistic branding
a fictional agency producing fictional research

lines.text: Its maxim is ars est celare artem: the art is to conceal the art. It works on three levels at once.
say: the art is to conceal the art. It works on three levels at once.

lines.text: Artistic: b0b.dev is the artwork, and need not announce itself as one.
lines.say: Artistic. B zero B dot dev is the artwork, and need not announce itself as one.

lines.text: Operational: the research, the tools and the map are real, and in use.
lines.say: Operational. The research, the tools, and the map are real, and in use.

lines.text: Recursive: it investigates secrecy, surveillance and power, and keeps an ambiguity of its own.
lines.say: Recursive. It investigates secrecy, surveillance, and power, and keeps an ambiguity of its own.

lines.text: The audience becomes an investigator of the investigator.

lines.text: It stands between intelligence research and conceptual art, between open-source intelligence and operational fiction, between espionage mythology and the archive.
It has the appearance of an obscure intelligence organisation, and claims no government affiliation, credential or endorsement.
The identity may be ambiguous. The evidence must not be.

shots.head: The distinction · b0b.dev
shots.text: The identity may be ambiguous. The evidence must not be.

lines.text: Its insignia is embroidered on a navy field jacket.
The motto across the top, six stars below, lightning from the centre, and a figure in a trench coat and fedora, carrying a case.
The seal carries the authority of military insignia; the figure is close to a cartoon. Both are meant.
The jacket is not merchandise. It is an artifact: the organisation, made physical.
In 1968 Marcel Broodthaers opened a museum in his house in Brussels: eagles in glass cases, and signs saying this was not a work of art.
say: opened a museum in his house in Brussels: eagles in glass cases, and signs saying this was not a work of art.

lines.text: Walid Raad’s Atlas Group, a fictional foundation, archives Lebanon’s civil wars in documents attributed to sources he invented.
lines.say: Walid Rahd’s Atlas Group, a fictional foundation, archives Lebanon’s civil wars in documents attributed to sources he invented.

lines.text: The Yes Men pose as spokespeople for real organisations, and speak in their name.
b0b.dev differs from all three in one respect: the intelligence work is real. And it wears no real organisation’s name.
lines.say: B zero B dot dev differs from all three in one respect: the intelligence work is real. And it wears no real organisation’s name.

shots.head: Precedents
shots.tag: PRECEDENTS · READ AT WIKIPEDIA, 21 OCT 2026 · NO WORK OF THEIRS IS SHOWN
rows: Musée d’Art Moderne, Département des Aigles

shots.head: The difference
rows: it wears no real organisation’s name

lines.text: An official body usually establishes its authority through its identity, and asks the public to trust its findings.
b0b.dev turns that round. Its identity is deliberately ambiguous; its findings are open to anyone who checks them.
lines.say: B zero B dot dev turns that round. Its identity is deliberately ambiguous; its findings are open to anyone who checks them.

lines.text: Don’t trust b0b.dev. Examine the evidence.
lines.say: Don’t trust B zero B dot dev. Examine the evidence.

shots.head: The paradox · b0b.dev
shots.text: Don’t trust b0b.dev. Examine the evidence.

lines.text: The website is the operational interface. The report is the dossier: twenty-five sections, every claim tiered and sourced.
The map holds {TOTAL} sites, and every line between them carries the tier of what the record shows.
lines.say: The map holds {TOTALWORDS} sites, and every line between them carries the tier of what the record shows.

lines.text: The films, an announcement made to be played outdoors, twelve stickers, and a public ledger of what it got wrong.
Every claim carries its tier and its source: documented, attributed, labeled, contested or unsupported. Nothing moves up a tier by repetition.
One identified crawler: it obeys robots.txt, never disguises itself, and records every refusal as a null.
lines.say: One identified crawler. It obeys robots dot T X T, never disguises itself, and records every refusal as a null.

lines.text: Quotes and figures are read at the source, and the AI assistance is disclosed.
A claim a primary source contradicts is lowered or removed, whoever raised it.
